text: The use of legalese and substantial involvement of the legal department in corporate communications substantially damages the originality and authenticity of those communications, making them mediated and less effective.
citation: Mark Fenwick, Wulf A. Kaal, Erik P. M. Vermeulen, The ‘Unmediated’ and ‘Tech-Driven’ Corporate Governance of Today's Winning Companies (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2922176

isBasedOn.name: The ‘Unmediated’ and ‘Tech-Driven’ Corporate Governance of Today's Winning Companies

abstract: The use of legalese and any substantial involvement of the legal department in corporate communications can have a substantial detrimental effect on the originality and authenticity of corporate communications, making them mediated and less effective.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: corporate communications intended to build trust and dialogue with stakeholders
